body.prompt: Photorealistic industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: what happens when light reaches a black hole. image[1] = exact proportions, 3/4 front view and layout: lens right of centre, flash window upper left, shutter and slide switch on top left over the grip, USB-C on the right side. image[2] = black hole with photon ring and lensed accretion disk. image[3] = soft light-grey tubes wrapping a dark core. image[4] and image[5] = only for machined surface detail. Matte black core = the black hole; satin light-grey tubes = the light; lens = event horizon, a deep black funnel with a real recessed lens. Idea ORDER TO DISORDER: the left grip half is crisp and ordered (machined block, knurled pads, engraved scale); towards the lens the surface melts into soft disordered tubes that tangle and flow into the event-horizon funnel. Rich functional detail: diamond-knurled grip pads, engraved degree scale around the lens, a small red index triangle, ribbed machined rings, tiny flush screws, fine vent slots, clean seams. Printable PLA forms, one camera centred on pure white, soft neutral light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses
